title: Mini-batched A/B matrix controller with synthetic smoke and fast revert
author: Priya Nair
release_notes: Adds a lightweight A/B matrix controller that performs mini-batched shadow seeding with synthetic smoke checks and an automated fast-revert path. Improves safety of multivariate promotes with lower cost and shorter feedback loops.
description: Motivation: Large A/B matrices and cohort-based canaries are powerful but costly and slow to get signal for small model diffs. This PR introduces a mini-batched A/B matrix controller that (1) seeds many small matrix cells in shadow using mini-batches, (2) runs a synthetic smoke simulator to detect immediate regressions, and (3) provides an automated fast-revert flow for any cell that exceeds configured anomaly thresholds. Design highlights: mini-batching groups multiple shadow sessions into compact test batches to improve GPU packing and trace correlation; a synthetic smoke generator replays sampled session patterns to create deterministic quick-health signals; and the controller snapshots variant routing state so a revert is an atomic short-circuit operation rather than a slow traffic migration. Checklist: - [x] Controller core (routing + state snapshot) - [x] Synthetic smoke simulator and replay harness - [x] Telemetry hooks (per-cell latency, error-rate, divergence) - [x] Fast-revert API and CLI command - [x] Unit + integration tests - [x] Runbook and rollout playbook (docs) Testing summary: Local unit tests + integration environment validated against a 3x3 A/B matrix with synthetic user traces. E2E on staging used 10k synthetic sessions over 30m to exercise backpressure and revert. Performance: end-to-end shadow pass adds ~3-6ms median tail per request in instrumented setups due to mini-batch aggregation; cost tradeoff measured to be ~0.4x of prior full-cell seeding because of batched packing. Rollout plan: merge to main behind feature flag; enable for internal staging only for 48h; lift to limited prod cohort (5%) and run synthetic smoke checks for 1h before expanding. If smoke signals exceed thresholds, fast-revert triggers and the revert runbook is executed. Related work: builds on the traffic-seeding and shadow bridge components (ENG-7123), but focuses on matrixed multivariate experiments with deterministic synthetic probes. Risks & mitigation: small risk of false positives from synthetic smoke -> configuration default keeps conservative thresholds and requires two independent anomaly signals (latency OR divergence AND error spike) to trigger an automated revert. Rollback quality: snapshot-based revert ensures session-consistency during reversion.
commits: 4 commits: 1) Add controller skeleton and config schema; 2) Implement mini-batch packing and deterministic seed selection; 3) Synthetic smoke harness + smoke test scenarios; 4) Add revert snapshot API, tests, and runbook updates.
review_comments: Ellen Park: Nice separation of concerns. Two asks: (1) add explicit timeout on smoke replay so it can't block controller loops, (2) ensure metrics have cell-id tag for downstream slicing.
Priya Nair (author): Added smoke replay timeout and cell-id tagging; pushed follow-up commit. PTAL.
Jonah Reed: Concern about snapshot GC — if snapshots accumulate we may hit disk pressure. Suggest TTL-based compaction; also add a GC metrics gauge.
Priya Nair: Implemented TTL compaction with configurable default (7d) and metric for active snapshots.
Sasha Ivanov: Ran perf bench vs existing shadow-seed (3-node env). Looks promising; approve after one nit on logging verbosity.
risk_assessment: Medium: introduces new orchestration path and synthetic probe; defaulted off behind feature flag. Mitigations: conservative default thresholds, snapshot TTL, and detailed runbook provided.
rollout_strategy: Feature-flagged on main. Staging gating: 48h. Production: 5% cohort for 1h with synthetic smoke checks; expand if stable. Automated fast-revert triggers on combined signals; manual abort allowed via rwctl fast-revert
notes_for_oncall: If controller emits 'smoke:anomaly' for >3 cells within 5m, run rwctl fast-revert --matrix=<id> and escalate to oncall SRE. Dashboard: Rollouts > AB Matrix > <pr-matrix-id>
documentation: Added docs/runbooks/ab_matrix_playbook.md with step-by-step rollout and revert playbook, plus example rwctl commands and observability dashboard URL.
changelog_entry: Introduce mini-batched A/B matrix controller with synthetic smoke checks and fast-revert; default disabled behind feature flag.
post_merge_actions: Enable feature flag in staging; schedule 2h monitoring window with SRE; follow-up issue created to add UX controls in Console (ENG-9472).
